probes.question: How many symbols does the binary system use?
True or false: each binary digit is called a bit.

image.alt: Rows of zeros and ones in a black typeface filling the whole frame.

body.question: Almost every modern computer represents numbers using only 0 and 1. According to the usual explanation, why?
options: It is simple to build with logic gates, and resists noise
body.reveal: Binary has just two symbols, 0 and 1, and each digit is called a bit. It is straightforward to implement in digital circuitry using logic gates and is robust against noise. Gottfried Leibniz is credited with inventing the modern binary system.
